title: The editable foundation
summary: The first Windows preview brings image annotation, editable projects, and a dependable save workflow into one native Rust editor.

Added: Open PNG and JPEG images and annotate with arrows, rectangles, and opaque redaction.
Save editable projects with the original image embedded, then reopen and keep working.
Export flattened PNGs from the editor or the shared command-line engine.
Improved: Save As and Save / Discard / Cancel prompts protect unsaved edits.
Undo and redo track the saved state; exporting an image keeps project changes marked as unsaved.
File dialogs start in the current project's folder.

limitations: Windows x64 portable preview; the application is not code-signed.
Screen capture, global hotkeys, text, and callouts are still in development.
Editable projects retain original pixels. Share a flattened PNG for redacted content.
